# xargs

Build and run command lines from standard input through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
printf 'one\ntwo\n' | moonx cli/xargs -n 1 printf '%s\n'

moonx cli/xargs -0 -n 10 printf '%s\n' < names.nul
```

Batch input items into child arguments, with optional replacement, delimiters, size limits and parallel execution.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-0`, `--null` | Read NUL-delimited items without quote or backslash processing. |
| `-d VALUE`, `--delimiter VALUE` | Separate input items with the selected byte. |
| `-n VALUE`, `--max-args VALUE` | Limit arguments per invocation. |
| `-r`, `--no-run-if-empty` | Do not invoke the command for empty input. |
| `-I VALUE`, `--replace VALUE` | Replace TEXT using logical input lines. |
| `-P VALUE`, `--max-procs VALUE` | Run at most N batches concurrently. Default: `1`. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Child execution requires launcher permission. Arbitrary invalid byte sequences cannot always be transported as host arguments.
- Default tokenization interprets quoting and backslashes; use -0 for NUL-separated filenames.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
